_comment: EVENTLOG-1. A run log that fills rolls into a next part, and the name of
that part is decided in TWO places: the engine (PowerShell) writes it, the
dashboard (JavaScript) reads it. If the two ever disagree the log silently
stops at part one and nobody is told.
So this is the one list of cases, and both are held to it:

cases.why: the first roll, which is the one that happens
and the next, and the next
nine to ten, not nine to 9-2
a document at the root of the run, with no folder
a hyphen in the name is not a part number
and the number after it still is
a dot in a FOLDER is not the extension
